opening.argument: The speaker presents Litecoin price analysis, with a chart and two conditional paths: a breakdown toward $41 or a reversal toward resistance at $70-$99. Neither path is presented as a guaranteed return or a concrete purchase opportunity. The requests to subscribe and comment seek audience engagement, not payment, credentials, or financial participation. The speaker also describes the analysis as personal opinion, not financial advice.

citations.quote: we could either break down and retest the 2022 low at $41 or we can get some sort of miraculous reversal which will push us back into another attempt at breaking resistance overhead at $70 to $99
none of this is financial advice. It is just my opinion.
